 The Tampa Bay left fielder robbed Sal Frelick of extra bases at Tropicana Field with the Rays facing a 2-0 series deficit
 By
 Ryan Gaydos OutKick 
 Published

 close Video Ray vs Brewers World Series Game 2 Highlights | MLB on FOX 
 Check out the best highlights from the Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers in World Series Game 2.
 When it’s the World Series, you gotta give your all. Tampa Bay Rays left fielder Chandler Simpson did that on Monday night in Game 3 against the Milwaukee Brewers.
 Brewers batter Sal Frelick hit a sharp liner to left field at Tropicana Field . Frelick thought the ball might have either been over Simpson’s head or, even better, a home run. If Simpson doesn’t make the play, the ball may have caromed off the wall and back to center field.

 Tampa Bay Rays left fielder Chandler Simpson catches a fly out hit by Milwaukee Brewers right fielder Sal Frelick during the second inning of Game 3 of baseball's World Series on Monday, Oct. 26, 2026, in St. Petersburg, Fla. (AP Photo/Morry Gash) 
 Instead, Simpson turned the jets on. He made a leaping grab and crashed face first into the wall. He hung onto the ball and was able to get it back to the infield before Garrett Mitchell could advance to second base.
 Tampa Bay saved a run and the possibility of giving momentum to Milwaukee early in the game.
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE 
 Tampa Bay Rays left fielder Chandler Simpson is caught on a steal attempt by Milwaukee Brewers second baseman Brice Turang during the first inning of Game 3 of baseball's World Series on Monday, Oct. 26, 2026, in St. Petersburg, Fla. (AP Photo/Chris O'Meara) 
 The second-year outfielder may need to step up a little bit more for the Rays as they came into the game facing a 2-0 deficit. Simpson has been 3-for-8 in the series with an RBI and two strikeouts. But if the team is going to be inspired by defensive magic, Simpson may have brought it.
 Milwaukee and Tampa Bay were two of the best teams in baseball all year. They each came into the series as the No. 1 seed in the postseason, having earned byes into their respective Division Series.
 Tampa Bay Rays left fielder Chandler Simpson waits for batting practice prior to Game 3 of baseball's World Series on Monday, Oct. 26, 2026, in St. Petersburg, Fla., between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Tampa Bay Rays. (AP Photo/Chris O'Meara)

 The Brewers defeated the Rays 3-2 in Game 1 and 5-4 in Game 2. The intensity of the games have been almost too close for comfort. But that’s baseball, Suzyn.
